vendor_reference.source: NVIDIA A10G datasheet; reference only, not used as denominator

notes: Bandwidth denominators are the best of measured copy/fill/read kernels on 1 GiB buffers in this exact software environment. The MFU denominator is measured TF32-disabled SGEMM (cuBLAS FP32 FMA path on CUDA cores); tensor-core peaks are never used because the routed-reduction kernels accumulate through FP32 CUDA-core ops.
